labels.raw_data_evidence: Activity intervals recorded at ~21:00 each baseline day; sleep starts ~22:44-22:58.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires activity intervals for timing comparisons with subsequent sleep.
labels.rationale: Data contains both activity timing and sleep timing, enabling the temporal context comparison the item describes. Supported contextual connection.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Sleep start times are recorded (e.g., 22:50), but no pre-bed activity data exists.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires information about pre-bed activities for targeted advice.
labels.rationale: Pre-bed activities are unknown from wearable data alone; cannot apply quiet-time advice specifically.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No commute or transport data is recorded in the wearable observations.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires established sedentary commuting and transport/mobility context.
labels.rationale: Commute context is completely unknown; generic suggestion with no data connection.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Window steps dropped to mean 2321 from baseline 7998; activity duration dropped to mean 4.86 min from 55.2 min.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Observable condition: low or declining movement gives opportunity to add activity.
labels.rationale: Severe activity decline observed in window period. The general principle that some activity is better than none provides supported contextual connection to this pattern.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No nap data is recorded in the wearable observations.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires nap history to be known.
labels.rationale: Nap history is unknown; item conditions not met.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Activity duration dropped from baseline mean 55.2 min to window mean 4.86 min; steps from 7998 to 2321.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Observable condition: recently low or reduced physical activity.
labels.rationale: The sharp activity decline in the window satisfies the observable condition of recently reduced physical activity. Gradual buildup advice is contextually relevant.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No screen or light exposure data is recorded.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires known bright-screen exposure shortly before bed.
labels.rationale: Screen exposure is unknown; cannot attribute any observed pattern to screens.

labels.raw_data_evidence: All sleep periods are overnight (start ~22:42-22:58, end 07:00); no shift work indicated.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires daytime sleep associated with shift work.
labels.rationale: Only ordinary overnight sleep is recorded; shift work is unknown. Item not applicable.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Sleep duration values (e.g., 470 min) are reported alongside sleep start/end timestamps defining a longer period.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires device-estimated sleep duration and sleep boundaries to be available.
labels.rationale: Both estimated sleep duration and sleep boundaries are present in the data. This item correctly explains that the duration metric differs from the full sleep period.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No television viewing data is recorded.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires prolonged sitting while watching television to be established.
labels.rationale: Screen habits are unknown; conditions not met.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Wake time is exactly 07:00 every day; no insomnia symptoms reported.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires recent bad night and sleeping difficulties to be reported.
labels.rationale: No reported sleeping difficulty; wake time is perfectly regular. Item not applicable.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Baseline mean sleep 470.5 min (~7.84h), window mean 469.4 min (~7.82h); age band 18-60.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires sleep duration below recommendation for adults aged 18-60 (at least 7 hours).
labels.rationale: Core direct explanation: observed sleep consistently meets the age-specific CDC recommendation of 7+ hours for the 18-60 age band throughout both periods.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Steps dropped ~71% (7998 to 2321) and activity minutes dropped ~91% (55.2 to 4.86).
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires steps change while other activity may differ; cautions against concluding total exercise from steps alone.
labels.rationale: Relevant caveat: step count drop might not capture all activity types, though active minutes also declined sharply. Provides important measurement context.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Weekday/weekend sleep start means are identical (649.5 min) in baseline; wake times are all 07:00.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires bedtime or wake time to differ substantially between weekdays and weekends.
labels.rationale: Weekday and weekend sleep times are similar (identical means in baseline). The non-applicable condition is explicitly met.

labels.raw_data_evidence: All vitals (RHR, HRV, sleep) are present for all 42 days with adequate coverage.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires a vital to be missing with limited night-time data.
labels.rationale: No missing vitals observed; conditions not met.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Single synthetic device used throughout; no device switch recorded.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires heart-rate series to involve a device or algorithm change.
labels.rationale: No device switch in this same-device series; conditions not met.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Sleep duration ranges 462-478 min across all days; individual variation exists around ~7.8h mean.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires adult sleep duration to be under review.
labels.rationale: Contextualizes the observed ~7.8h sleep within normal individual variation for adults. Duration alone is not diagnostic.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Both RHR (mean 56.1-56.3 bpm) and HRV RMSSD (mean 44.8-45.3 ms) are reported simultaneously.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires HRV and heart-rate estimates to be interpreted together.
labels.rationale: Directly clarifies that the two simultaneously reported metrics measure different physiological quantities.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No emergency response deployment context is recorded.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires confirmed emergency-response deployment context.
labels.rationale: Deployment context is unknown; item specific to deployed emergency responders.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Age band is 18-60, not 13-17.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires teenage age group to be established.
labels.rationale: Age band contradicts required population; item not applicable to adults.

labels.raw_data_evidence: RHR readings are stable (variance <1 bpm); wear coverage is complete at 720 min/day.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires heart-rate readings to be unreliable or wear quality to change.
labels.rationale: No evidence of fit problems; RHR readings appear stable and reliable throughout.

labels.raw_data_evidence: HRV metric is explicitly labeled hrv_rmssd_ms with values 43-47 ms.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires HRV records to identify RMSSD as their metric.
labels.rationale: Core direct match: observed metric is explicitly RMSSD, confirming the measurement definition used in the data.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Only 14-day window of device data; no reported sleeping difficulties.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires months-long sleeping difficulties or reported insomnia symptoms.
labels.rationale: Only brief record without reported problems; conditions not met.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Nighttime coverage ranges 482-498 min (>3h) on all nights; HRV RMSSD is reported daily.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires compatible collection definition and sleep coverage for overnight HRV.
labels.rationale: Confirms the data meets the >3h sleep requirement for valid overnight HRV estimation. Contextualizes how the observed HRV metric is collected.

labels.raw_data_evidence: RHR recorded over 42 consecutive days (28 baseline + 14 window) showing stable 55-57 bpm range.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires repeated resting heart-rate readings or a recent change.
labels.rationale: Supports interpreting the stable multi-week RHR trend rather than focusing on any single daily value.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Daily RHR values reported (55-57 bpm) distinct from any exercise heart rate.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires resting heart rate observations to be available.
labels.rationale: Clarifies the definition of the reported RHR metric as measured while still and well-rested, relevant for interpreting the stable values.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No subjective tiredness or energy data is recorded.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires reported tiredness limiting activity and subjective energy pattern.
labels.rationale: Tiredness and energy context unknown; generic advice not grounded in observed data.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No bedroom environment data (light, noise, temperature) is recorded.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires known disruptive bedroom environment.
labels.rationale: Environment unknown; wearable data cannot establish bedroom conditions.

labels.raw_data_evidence: HRV RMSSD stable at 43-47 ms across 42 days for this individual.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires an HRV level or trend to be under review.
labels.rationale: Provides context that stable HRV should be compared to personal baseline, not universal norms. Relevant for interpretation.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No relaxation issues or stress indicators reported; RHR/HRV stable.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires reported difficulty relaxing or request for routine options.
labels.rationale: Generic optional practice; no connection to observed data patterns. RHR/HRV alone do not establish stress.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Activity intensity is unknown throughout; window activity is minimal (mean 4.86 min).
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires documented aerobic activity already reaching the adult guideline.
labels.rationale: Intensity unknown and activity far below guidelines; conditions not met.

labels.raw_data_evidence: All activity intervals have intensity labeled 'unknown'.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No chronic health conditions or disabilities are recorded.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No insomnia symptoms reported; activity occurs at 21:00 with sleep starting ~22:44-22:58.

labels.rationale: No insomnia symptoms reported; temporal adjacency alone does not establish insomnia.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Sleep duration is consistently ~7.8h (adequate); no infection indicators exist.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Daily RHR values (55-57 bpm) are reported; no sleeping heart rate metric is separately provided.

labels.rationale: Sleep stable despite activity drop; item warns against causal claims but doesn't explain the observed pattern. Temporal co-occurrence does not imply causation.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No insomnia symptoms reported; sleep duration is adequate.
